content: Banabasi ni Saule aba anaku Ketiwa ni ku Tumiwa
Cwale mu Ndoo ya Nyambe namu Antiyoki kame kuna kwikala aanuhi naaiyeti, Banabasi, Simyoni ona kwisaniwa Nija, Lusiusi namu Sileni ni Manaeni omunjili no manduna no kuta ya Heloda omubusisi ni Saule.
Abo alemine oku kubamena Ombumu ni kukuyumena eilya, Emebo No Kukena sebeli yaamba nji, “Muni ketele Banabasi ni Saule atende omusebezi owo ninaa isanene.”
Cwale aba ana kumana okuuyumena eilya ni kulapela sebeli abeeka amaoko woo beulu yoo ni kwaafundula
Mu Sipulasi
Cwale, bakutumiwa ku Mebo No Kukena sebeli ata ku Selusia, mi okutunda abo sebeli alutela mu Sipulasi.
Cwale aba anoka keela mu Salamisi, sebeli aaka kutaza eliywi lya Nyambe mu tindoo no ilapelo no Majuda. Kame ana kweenda ni Jowani ona kwaatusanga.
Cwale aba anaende mu sooli mane okakeela ku Pafosi, sebeli akuwana ni mulume no mabibo, omunuhi no mapwa no Majuda no Litina lya Bal-Jesu.
Kame ana kwikalanga ku mubusisi Selgiusi Paulusi, omulume no kushangama. Woyo sebeli oisana Banabasi ni Saule na kulakaza okuyupa eliywi lya Nyambe.
Kono Elimasi no mabibo (kakuli neli yonyene etaluso no litina lyaye) sebeli wahanyeza, ni kweteka okukanisa omubusisi nji alese okupumena.
Kono Saule, woyo wisaniwa kame nji Paulusi, sebeli wiyala ni Mebo No Kukena mi sebeli omwaliketa
ni kwamba nji, “Weene omwana no kwiiba, wene esila no inu yonje nokuluka, wene wiyalile ouyi onje, kaulesele okusinya endila no kooloka ya Mbumu!

Cwale omone, elyoko lya Mbumu kame lili beulu yowe, kame sotende esibofu mi uulwe okumona eliywaa ba nako icana.” Ababo okwilola ni uwi sebeli ifuka amiyo aye, mi sebeli osaela omunu no kumwendisa ni Lyoko.
Cwale omubusisi sebeli opumena aba ana kumona esi sineeyi, kakuli kame ana kukomokisiwa ku tuto ya Mbumu.
Mu Antiyoki namu Pisidiya
Cwale Paulusi naa ana kwenda noo sebeli atunda mu Pafosi ni kuta okakeela ni ku Pega namu Pamfiliya. Mi Jowani sebeli waasiya ni kuuka ku Jelusalema.
Kono onyene sebeli atunda mu Pega nuuka keela mu Antiyoki namu Pisidiya, mi ba liywaa no Pumulo sebeli aingena mu ndoo no milapelo nuu ka ikala banji.
Munyima no ku bala omulawo naanuhi a Nyambe, aendisi no ndoo no milapelo sebeli aatumena omunu ona kwamba nji, “Abaange, nji kame muli ni liywi no kususuweza aanu, mu lyaambe.”
Cwale Paulusi sebeli oimana, mi yo kobetite ni Lyoko, sebeli wamba nji, “Alume no Isilaele, naanyi mucila Nyambe, komuteetete!
Nyambe no aanu aa no Isilaele kame ana kukuketela asitetu ni kwaakulisa asiikalile mu naha no Engepita, ni Lyoko no kwimana sebeli waatundisamo,
cwale mu myaka no kukwana makumi anee (40) sebeli oyanda noo mu lihalaupa.
Cwale aba ana kumana okuyundisa amasika mutanu naayili mu naha no Kanana, mi sebeli waaba enaha yoo kanyi ayooli.
Cwale munyima nweeyo, Sebeli waaba aatuli okutwala ba nako no munuhi wa Nyambe Samwele, mi kame sina kushimba emyaka ina kukwana emwenda inee ni makumi atanu (450).
Cwale aba anaku kumbela nji abiwe ombumu, Nyambe sebeli waaba Saule omwana Kishi, omulume no lusika lwa Benjamine, ni kubusa emyaka inakukwana makumi anee (40).

Cwale aba ana kumana oku mutundisa, sebeli oimeka Dabida okutenda ombumu woo, yonaku pakiwa ni kwamba eyaye nji, ‘Kame nina wana Dabida omwana Jese, omulume woyo okolwisa omucima wange, woyo sotenda eyo nisinga yonje.’
Mu lusika no mulume uyu Nyambe na liti omuyoyisi no Isilaele, yonyene Jesu, kanyi omo ana kusepiseza.
Cwale Jesu yo kasiiya kale Jowani yo wakutaza kale ekolobezo no kubaka kwaanu onje no Isilaele.

Cwale Jowani yoli beebi niku mana omusebezi waye, sebeli nji, ‘Ngasibine muyambuta nji time anyine? Kasa mene yonyene. Kokuulwa, kono munyima yange omunjili okeile, simba etinjatangwa naku makodo aye sitwese okwa nungutula.’
“Abaange, aanu no lusika lwa Abulahama naanyi monje aa acila Nyambe, kwaaci na kwiiyi elin̄usa no kuyoyisa.
Kakuli awo ayoya mu Jelusalema naa endisi oo, mulibaka nji kasi limuka Jesu simba okwayupa amaywii no anuhi a Nyambe aa abaliwa ba liywaa ni liywaa eli no Pumulo, naiyateetete eyi no kumwatula.
Simba nji kasikuwana omubonda owo ofanena elifu, sebeli akumbela Pilato kwalukulwela yonyene nji aibaiwe.
Cwale aba ana kumana okwiiyateteta eyo inakun̄oliwa eyaye, sebeli amutundisa ba sitondo ni kumu langeka mu libita.
Kono Nyambe naku mwiingula kwaafu,
ni kumoniwa mu maywaa no kupula kwaao ana kwiiya naye okutunda ku Galileya okuta ku Jelusalema, awo atendile cwale apaki aye kwaanu.
Cwale na tumilitele eliywi no kuwaba elyo Nyambe ana kusepisa kwaa njekulyetu nji,
esi ana iyatetete mwaaci anoo mu kwingula Jesu, kanyi kame omo kun̄olelwe mu Lismu no wiili nji,

content.text: Cwale esisupo no niti aba ana mwingula kwaafu, nji katamba kuukela okoola, ya naamba Nyambe nji,
ni timbuyoti no niti tina kusepisiwa kwa Dabida.’
Cwale ni mu lisamu linjili nakwambiwa nji,
‘Kutamba kupumenena woyo no kukena wowe nji amone okoola.’
Kakuli Dabida aba ana kumana okusebeza mu maywaa aye eso sina kusaelwa kwa Nyambe, sebeli ofa, ni kulangekwa kwa sitaye, ni kumona okoola.
Kono woyo anaingula Nyambe, katamba kumona okoola.
Cwalehe Abange, mu limuke nji, mwa yonyene woyo mulume na mwambeliwa oku lemenwa eibi yenu,
mwa yonyene omunu yonje woyo opumena kame alukululwa ku inu yonje eyo kamutwese oku lukululwa mu mulawo wa Mushe.
Mu tokomele nakubu, nji cwale mu lese okwiyelwa kweyo inambiwa kwaanuhi nji,
‘Komumone, anyi akamashungu, mu komoke, mi mufe!

content: Aba ana kusinga okubanamo, aanu sebeli akumbela nji atalusete einu eyo afanena okutalusetwa eli no Pumulo linjili.

Cwale asi mukopano aba ana kufundulwa, aendisi no Majuda no kupula na pulosebelite awo asebeleza Nyambe sebeli akon̄a Paulusi ni Banabasi, awo sebeli aambola noo, ni kwakutaza okongoteta mu sishemo sa Nyambe.
Eli no Pumulo lina kutatamako omunu yonje namu mulenen̄i sebeli oiya mukuungana bamweya mukuyupa eliywi lya Nyambe.
Kono aendisi no Majuda aba ana kumona elikwanamunu, sebeli ayupa omuna, ni ku kanana eyo ina kwambiwa kwa Paulusi, ni ku mushendoola.

Cwale Paulusi ni Bananbasi sebeli aambela mukwacila nji, “Kame ku lukeele nji eliywi lya Nyambe lyambelwe anyi oweli. Kono aba mulikana kame mukwatula mwenyene nji kamu fanenwe omooyo no kwaabwa, komumone, kame tusiulukela kwa simacaba.
Kakuli cwale Ombumu natu laelele nji,

content.text: ‘Kame nina kutumu nji otenda eliseli no asimacaba,
nji olita oku yoyisa mu litunga lyonje okutwala ku mamaneneno.’”

content: Cwale asimacaba aba ana kuyupa ngeso, sebeli awabelelwa, ni kukanyisa eliywi lya Nyambe, mi ano kupula aa ana ketelwe omoyo no kwaabwa, sebeli apumena.
Cwale eliywi lya Mbumu sebeli lihasana mu silalanda sonje eso.
Kono aendisi no Majuda sebeli asusueza akati aa aketukiwa naalume abusai no mulenen̄i, ni kwingulela Paulusi ni Banabasi amayando, mi sebeli aacita mu naha yoo.
Kono onyene sebeli atutula eliluli ku makondo oo, ni kuta ku Ikoniyamu.
Cwale aiyetwa sebeli aiyala okuwabelelwa ni Mebo no Kukena.
